notes: Input has no study, outcome or test locator. Replication report identifies its single-trace original claim. Original extracted independently from full paper, title and DOI verified; report identifies the otherwise unspecified target. Both effects are printed OLS coefficients; replication effect is printed as an OLS coefficient, not converted to requested Cohen's f^2. Analytic n not printed in report. A broad primary-paper search inadvertently surfaced a forbidden FORRT search snippet; it was not opened or used as extraction evidence. Primary authors' estimation PDF (https://osf.io/4emy9), p. 1, was also visually inspected: its Hispanic row confirms the coefficient and p-value; no sample n is printed. Its methods specify school-clustered sandwich standard errors. Original Table 3a n is the model sample, not the number of Hispanic children or high-poverty children alone.
